command: $r = Invoke-RestMethod "https://api.github.com/repos/pal1000/mesa-dist-win/releases/latest"; $a = $r.assets | Where-Object { $_.name -like "*release-msvc.7z" } | Select-Object -First 1; Invoke-WebRequest $a.browser_download_url -OutFile C:\mesa.7z; 7z x C:\mesa.7z -oC:\mesa -y; cmd /c "C:\mesa\systemwidedeploy.cmd auto"; [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("GALLIUM_DRIVER","llvmpipe","Machine"); [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable("MESA_GL_VERSION_OVERRIDE","4.5","Machine"); Write-Output "Mesa3D OpenGL 4.5 Software GPU installed"
